description: This file defines the ShoppingCartItem entity class, which models an item within a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It manages shopping cart item details such as product, quantity, pricing, attributes, and audit information.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item in a shopping cart, including product details, quantity, pricing, attributes, and audit information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the shopping cart item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the shopping cart item.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information section.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information section.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the associated shopping cart.

methods.name: setShoppingCart
methods.description: Associates this item with a shopping cart.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Gets the identifier of the product.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the product.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the Product object.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the Product object.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product in the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of attribute items associated with this cart item.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Replaces the attribute items for this cart item.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds an attribute item to the cart item.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes an attribute item from the cart item.

methods.name: removeAllAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attribute items.

methods.name: getItemPrice
methods.description: Gets the final price of this item, including rebates.

methods.name: setItemPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of this item.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Gets the subtotal (item price * quantity).

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal for this item.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Returns the price details, including raw prices.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the price details.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if the item is marked as obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Marks or unmarks the item as obsolete.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.
